title: Habit tracker
summary: A person describes a simple habit tracker they want for themselves. They want to add habits, tick them off each day and see their current streak.
intent: Build a personal daily habit tracker to check whether the idea is worth pursuing.
functional_requirements: The user can add a habit with a name and an optional emoji.
The user can mark each habit as done for today, and undo it.
Each habit shows its current streak of consecutive days.
The user can delete a habit.
A summary at the top shows how many habits are done today out of the total.
user_stories: As a user, I want to add habits so that I can track what I care about.
As a user, I want to tick off a habit for today so that I keep my streak going.
As a user, I want to see my streaks so that I stay motivated.
